name: Dar Global PLC
summary: Dar Global PLC, along with its various subsidiaries, is principally engaged in developing and selling real estate ventures across the Middle East and Europe. These projects primarily consist of secondary residences or holiday homes. Beyond its core property operations, the company offers a diverse range of auxiliary services. These encompass several types of consulting, including economic and trade advisory, engineering and technical guidance, business management, corporate planning, and real estate information. Additionally, it provides creative and marketing services, such as computer and graphic design, as well as comprehensive advertising solutions spanning design, production, agency work, release, and exhibition management. The firm also actively participates in the acquisition and divestment of existing real estate properties. Established in 2017, Dar Global PLC maintains its primary business location in London, United Kingdom, and functions as a subsidiary of Dar Al Arkan Global Real Estate Development LLC.
